prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1248; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover on the vehicle is cracked and the left taillight assembly is broken, with scuffing along the rear quarter panel that lines up well with the reported impact in the parking lot. Nothing seen so far points to older damage, and no prior repairs are known on this vehicle. The plan is to replace the bumper cover and taillight, refinish the quarter panel, and check the rear sensor bracket once the cover is off. Two similar charges posted on the same day are still being reviewed before payment. The labor hours look somewhat generous for this scope of work and are being checked against standard repair times.
